name: 018_trend_breakout_long_tf240
hypothesis: R1.0 showed that the long breakout's expectancy is flat across every regime - by BTC's 30-day trend at entry it was -0.026 in a bear market and +0.025 in a strong bull, with corr(R, trend) = +0.011 - so this is not a disguised long-a-bull-market bet, which is the usual way a long-only idea dies. The mechanism being claimed is narrower: a break of the n-bar high taken in the direction of the higher-timeframe trend, in a market ADX calls trending, is continuation because the counterparty is the seller who is late to a rising market. Direction is fixed long on purpose, because when the grid was allowed to choose, TRAIN chose long and the short leg lost significantly (Exp 015). [Timeframe variant of 018_trend_breakout_long, 15m -> 240m, mode chart: same bar counts and ATR multiples, hold x16, pct stop x4.000.]
